'''Gualamas''' were beautiful, herbivorous [[ungulate]]s indigenous to the grassy plains of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], also found on the moon [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].

==Biology and appearance==
Gualamas were an [[Diet/Legends|herbivorous]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Their diet included [[Grass/Legends|wild grasses]] and [[Flower/Legends|flowers]]. The two horns on top of their head were upright and curved forward, and they had a pair of tusks, one each on either side of their mouths. They were quadrapedal with split hooves. A gualama's [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]] was especially long at the ends of their single tail.<ref name="Wildlife" />

==Behavior==
The tail of a gualama was expressive and used for communication. By pointing a front leg forward with an upraised tail fluffed out like an [[Umbrella/Legends|umbrella]], a gualama could ask another, "Where is the nearest watering hole?" Some of the emotions conveyed through different positions were mourning or feeling threatened. In flight, their tails were raised like banners.<ref name="Wildlife" />

[[File:Gualama4-woswfg.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A male gualama courts a female with a gesture of affection.]]
Gualamas typically lived in herds centered around a single [[Gender/Legends|male]] that protected and cared for multiple females and young, with up to twenty-five individuals in one herd. As male colts reached maturity, they would be run off by their patriarch to find a [[Reproduction/Legends|mate]] of their own. Until then, they roamed alongside and wrestled with other newly-matured males.<ref name="Wildlife" />

[[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queens]] of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] people and their [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens/Legends|handmaidens]] had a [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|royal]] herd of gualamas exclusively available for their use, guarded by tusk-cats. The royal herd was ridden during [[Theed]]side "[[Twirrling]]" parties.<ref name="Wildlife" />
